name: Small buckler
description: A little round shield you punch people with. Very light, and no help against anything that is not coming straight at your hand.
notes: A light buckler (ADR-0003 names the buckler as the light shield). Blocks as the wood-shield profile (no separate shield data yet). Weight 1.5 kg. Catalogue tier common (economy doc, light class 35-60). The economy doc has no shield band; priced as a helmet of the matching class. Authored for shop stock (mw-ju8.3); not for sale until a shop row stocks it (mw-ju8.5).
